meta.name: backup-and-recovery
meta.description: Protects and restores data — backup coverage and scope, retention, immutability against ransomware, and proving restores actually work. Use this to design a backup regime, verify restores, plan retention, protect backups from ransomware, or recover from data loss.

copy.tagline: 规划备份策略,验证数据恢复,防范勒索病毒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责数据安全,担心备份不可靠或遭遇勒索攻击。
copy.tagline_en: Design backup plans with verified restores and ransomware protection
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own data protection and want restores that actually work.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计备份方案：核对备份覆盖范围、按3-2-1规则安排多份拷贝、制定保留期限、测试恢复过程，并提醒你让备份不被勒索软件和恶意删除影响。
howto.when: 当你提到设计备份制度、验证恢复、规划保留、防勒索或恢复数据等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一份符合3-2-1规则的备份方案。
say.note: Claude 会给出备份份数、介质和异地存放的建议。

say.text: 怎么验证备份真的能恢复？
say.note: Claude 会说明测试恢复的方法和环境要求。

say.text: 备份保留多久，才不会违反删除义务？
say.note: Claude 会提示你需要对照法律和隐私要求来确定。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps design backup schemes: reconcile coverage, arrange copies per the 3-2-1 rule, set retention, test restores, and warn against ransomware and deletion risks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to design a backup regime, verify restores, plan retention, protect backups from ransomware, or recover from data loss.

say_en.text: Design a backup scheme following the 3-2-1 rule.
say_en.note: Claude suggests copy counts, media, and off-site storage.

say_en.text: How do I verify my backups actually restore?
say_en.note: Claude explains testing methods and environment needs.

say_en.text: How long should backups stay without violating deletion duties?
say_en.note: Claude notes legal and privacy checks for retention.
